description:
List tasks for a property. Filter by status (open/done), assignee user id, taskbox (column UUID or a status keyword: todo, in_progress, qa, done), parent (a ticket UUID, slug, or browser URL — returns that ticket's subtasks), or q (case-insensitive title search, min 2 chars). Paginated via next_cursor in the response.

Cost: 2 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// list open tasks in the IN PROGRESS column.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","status":"open","taskbox":"in_progress","limit":25}
```
name: list_tasks
title: Tasks
